```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
library(leaflet)
library(jsonlite)
```

```{r}
raw <- read_json("data/wildfires.geojson")
length(raw$features)
```

```{r}
fire <- raw$features[[1]]
names(fire)
first_boundary_coordinate <- fire$geometry$coordinates[[1]][[1]]
first_boundary_coordinate
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
fires <- tibble(features = raw$features) |>
  unnest_wider(features) |>
  unnest_wider(properties) |>
  unnest_wider(geometry, names_sep = "_") |>
  select(incident, gis_acres, fire_year, agency, state, geometry_coordinates) |>
  mutate(
    gis_acres = as.numeric(gis_acres),
    fire_year = as.integer(fire_year)
  )
```

```{r}
fires |>
  filter(str_detect(incident, "August")) |>
  nrow()

fires |>
  slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  select(incident, gis_acres, fire_year, agency, state)
```

```{r}
big_fires <- fires |>
  filter(gis_acres >= 100000)

top_fires <- big_fires |>
  slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE)
```

```{r}
boundary_coordinates <- top_fires$geometry_coordinates |>
  map(\(boundary) boundary[[1]]) |>
  purrr::list_flatten()
lng <- map_dbl(boundary_coordinates, \(point) point[[1]])
lat <- map_dbl(boundary_coordinates, \(point) point[[2]])

map <- leaflet() |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
  fitBounds(min(lng), min(lat), max(lng), max(lat))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(top_fires))) {
  fire <- top_fires[i, ]
  boundary <- fire$geometry_coordinates[[1]][[1]]

  map <- map |>
    addPolygons(
      lng = map_dbl(boundary, \(point) point[[1]]),
      lat = map_dbl(boundary, \(point) point[[2]]),
      popup = paste0(
        fire$incident,
        "<br>Year: ", fire$fire_year,
        "<br>Acreage: ", format(fire$gis_acres, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE)
      )
    )
}

map
```
